rules: primary single click sets active_id and selected_id only
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move active_id without opening; single-select may follow active according to surface registry, multi-select membership never follows arrows
Space toggles member_ids only on multi-select surfaces
double-click on row body or Enter on active eligible row opens the exact same default route
nested interactive control activation stops row-open behavior and performs only its own action
touch uses explicit labelled Open action; double-tap has no required meaning
return_restore: history entry records route, filter fingerprint, active/selected/member IDs, scroll anchor and focus token; on return restore surviving IDs else deterministic nearest-row then container fallback with explanation
